items.title: Wavlink路由器 栈溢出 设置导出CGI
items.title_zh: Wavlink路由器 栈溢出 设置导出CGI
items.summary_zh: 可访问设置导出CGI的攻击者可操纵strcpy参数触发栈溢出，导致设备崩溃或代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本；限制该CGI访问，关闭公网管理。
items.impact_scope: 路由器Web管理，通常内网/LAN暴露
items.description: A vulnerability was detected in Wavlink WL-WN530BE1-A 251117. This vulnerability affects the function strcpy of the file /cgi-bin/ExportAllSettings.cgi of the component Settings Export CGI. Performing a manipulation of the argument HTTP_COOKIE/X-Cmd results in stack-based buffer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: Wavlink路由器 wmapd命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵wmapd守护进程system函数参数注入系统命令，造成远程命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本；限制wmapd服务访问，勿暴露管理口。
items.repro_note: 需可达wmapd服务，操纵system函数参数注入命令
items.impact_scope: 路由器daemon，网络可达可远程攻击
items.description: A flaw has been found in Wavlink WL-WN592AX6 250422. This issue affects the function system of the component wmapd Daemon. Executing a manipulation can lead to os command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: Wavlink路由器 VPN上传命令注入
items.title_zh: Wavlink路由器 VPN上传命令注入
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可操纵uploadVpn.cgi的Type参数注入系统命令，可能导致远程命令执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本；限制该CGI访问并过滤Type参数。
items.impact_scope: 路由器Web CGI，管理面暴露可打
items.description: A security vulnerability has been detected in Wavlink WL-WN530BE1-A 251117. This affects the function popen of the file /cgi-bin/uploadVpn.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument Type leads to os command injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.

items.title: TRENDnet路由器 栈溢出 表单设置
items.title_zh: TRENDnet路由器 栈溢出 表单设置
items.summary_zh: 可访问formTcpipSetup的攻击者可提交超长字段触发栈溢出，导致设备崩溃或代码执行。
items.action_zh: 升级厂商修复版本；限制管理界面访问，关闭公网管理。
items.repro_note: 入口/goform/formTcpipSetup，向TCP/IP配置字段传超长值
items.impact_scope: 老旧路由器Web管理，暴露面有限
items.description: A vulnerability was found in TRENDnet TEW-432BRP 3.10B20. Affected by this vulnerability is the function formTcpipSetup of the file /goform/formTcpipSetup.
